items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I know Bud, but I never associated him with them at that point.

ctx.x: And then they originally had an alto player with him. Who I know very well. I can't think of his name. What's Bud Hunter? I think of Bud. I know Bud, but I never associated him with them at that point.
I think he was in Austin. I don't know whether before or after. Jacobson was not an Austinite, was he?
